name: Deborah
overview: The Bible presents Deborah as a remarkable figure who served both as a nurse to Rebekah and as a prophetess and judge of Israel. Her death is noted in Genesis, where she is buried beneath an oak tree near Bethel, called the Oak of Weeping. In Judges, Deborah is portrayed as a divinely appointed leader who judged Israel and inspired Barak to lead the Israelites in battle against Sisera, demonstrating her pivotal role in God's deliverance of His people.
